design: DESIGN-9 (owner approved 2026-11-02, build 449): the objective function and the inductive routing law; it replaces DESIGN-8's admission and pricing parts. DESIGN-8 still applies: the pool scarcity price, REVAS step 5, the first-turn-only local start, the ask-back, the calculator and the permission floors (build 447-448)
objective: same result as the newest top model at its highest reasoning, with less quota
constraint: for every request, P(success | chosen execution) >= P(success | reference) - tau, success judged on THIS request's skills and difficulty band; minimize total actual quota (answers, checks, retries, sub-agents, effort multipliers), each pool priced by scarcity (DESIGN-9 section 2)
reference_efforts_source: DESIGN-9 section 2: the reference is the newest top model at maximum reasoning, claude-fable-5-1@max and gpt-6-astra@max/ultra; every reference row is admissible and is the top of its frontier

pool_units.anthropic_shared: Cw: % of the Claude weekly pool (all models)
pool_units.openai_codex: Px: % of one Codex Pro weekly pool

cost_shape_source: a route is priced before it runs: the answer shape is every turn of two calls or fewer, whatever its realized output (review of 447); a workspace writer whose reading does work (a design, write or action task, or a workspace or execution need) is priced agentic (Core)

exchange.formula: price(pool) = ttr_w / remaining_w for w = the pool's unit window (its longest open window, the weekly one: Q is in its units); remaining_w = 1 - used_w/100; ttr_w = (resets_at_w - now) / window_length_w; any other window exhausted: no price (the pool cannot be drawn)
exchange.source: lead correction 2 (DESIGN-8, 2026-10-29): each pool priced by the share of its remaining allowance until its reset, from the providers' rate-limit data (routing_law.pools, the host's observations); no 1:1 and no headroom-threshold constant
exchange.stale_fallback: stale (past the host's valid_until_ms): each window not yet reset at its last observed share left with the whole window ahead (1 / remaining_w; plan usage only rises inside a window), an exhausted one no price until its reset (review of 447: a failed probe never prices a pool last seen scarce at pace); every window reset since, or no observation: the pool's smallest dispatchable remaining share with the whole window ahead (1 / remaining); no share at all: 1 (pace)

p_fail_inheritance: Round 3 of the 448 review (lead decision 2): E[Q] prices the event on which the RUNTIME escalates, and that escalation's step, for every row, and the release gate is judged on that draw (law_model is a report only). A pool reference is the top of the frontier and nothing runs after it: Q alone. A writer below the reference binds no ladder, so nothing runs after it either: Q alone (the step the law would take, its pool reference's answer, is the law_model report). A read-only row below the reference admitted with evidence (form b or c; the local row admitted by an audit or, DESIGN-9 section 4.8, by the owner as judge of a subjective request: form o) escalates only on the runtime's STRUCTURAL screen failure (descentStructurallySound: empty, cut off, an error; a tier gap never triggers it and is never priced), to the full answer at its target: Q + p_screen x Q(target). p_screen (Core lawScreenPFail) is measured from the ledger's screened attempts, the same screen for every row, keyed model@effort and pooled over families and surfaces, Laplace-smoothed: a row with evidence starts from its own pool reference's screen rate and its own screened attempts move it at the prior's weight, (f_c + runs_prior * p_ref) / (n_c + runs_prior); the references learn p_ref from a SHADOW structural screen recorded on every law-bound reference answer (never gating it; before round 3 no reference was ever screened and every row inherited the bare prior forever). A row admitted by a deterministic verifier (form a) is priced per class of its failures (Core lawDetClassPFail): p(repair) x Q_det_repair(T) + p(full) x Q_answer(T) at the family's reference T, the class rates from the verifier's judged outcomes on the same held-out request population (decision 1). A local REVAS verified start keeps its own Laplace estimate from its REVAS checks.
p_fail_learning: build 448 (DESIGN-8 step 5: every outcome updates p_fail): the committed ledger snapshot (judged runs and structural screens up to its through_ms) is the table's p_fail and p_screen; Core adds its own routing ledger's records settled after through_ms, by the same two counting rules (Core lawJudgedOutcome, keyed model@effort|law family from each record's law receipt; Core lawScreenOutcome, keyed model@effort). A judged outcome is the verdict of the verifier the law applies to that row: for the local model its REVAS check (revas_pass, revas_fail), its family's deterministic verifier (det_pass, det_fail, with the failure's class: full when no deliverable draft, else repair) or a structural failure (empty, not returned); for any other row its verifier or check verdict or structural screen. A REVAS check or repair attempt (a deterministic verifier's repair included) and an escalated attempt are never descents; a small-talk request's outcome is never recorded under another family (round 3: no re-read).

value_of_information.horizon: the evidence's lifetime, derived from data (round 4 of the 448 review, lead decision 3): an audit's verdict is evidence about one (candidate model, reference model) pair, so it lives until either changes in OS-1's catalog; the lifetime is the bound catalogs' measured mean interval between such changes (scripts/routing-law-audit.mjs evidenceLifetime over the catalog history: the observed span over the changes seen; with none seen the span itself, a lower bound), the saving accrues at the routing ledger's measured traffic rate over it (trafficRate), and the cost and the saving are priced along each pool's path; the availability value of a local start (small talk answered while every pool is exhausted) is not in the objective's units and is reported beside the VOI, never added to it (scripts/routing-law-f1-audit.mjs); round 5 of the 448 review: an audit is scheduled only when its PASS is reachable (the minimal paired audit: the smallest total n at which some reference spread lets zero discordant pairs meet n_parity with the committed grader sensitivity; none reachable: P(pass) 0, never run), it may accumulate across pool windows (each within the cap, its questions drawn once in one stratified random order fixed by the audit's lineage), the cap is counted in each pool's own reset window over every audit's spend, the saving is what Core would price after a pass (an admitted row's structural screen escalation) along the pool's price path over the lifetime left once the audit completes, against the whole remaining audit's cost, and P(pass) is the shared Laplace prior of a cell with no tier evidence
value_of_information.pass_rule: an answer passes when the local model grades every item of its frozen checklist as met; a question is informative when the audit reference's answer passes; FAIL when any question has the reference passing and the cell failing (a discordant pair); PASS when there is none and at least n questions are informative; else INCONCLUSIVE (never admits; more questions are planned). A PASS admits (form c) only as a parity audit: n = n_parity informative questions sampled at random across the family (review of 447); a cost-sized pass is provisional and admits nothing
value_of_information.source: DESIGN-8 step 6 moved into 447 (lead correction 3): the cap <= 1% of a pool's weekly allowance per week is DESIGN-8's (its 7-day horizon was replaced by the measured evidence lifetime in round 4 of the 448 review, lead decision 3); n is the parity bound ceil(ln(1 - confidence) / ln(1 - s * tau)) (review of 447: tau the family tiers' tightest percentage tau, s the grader's measured sensitivity); the confidence 0.9 is declared here and is NOT derived: it awaits the lead's decision (review of 447)

effort_label_source: O4 (owner 2026-10-29): the Claude app labels Max '3.5x or more usage'; applied against the next-lower step and only ever raising cost

local_start.rule: DESIGN-8 step 2 (build 448) and DESIGN-9 section 4.8 (build 449): the local model is ADMISSIBLE for a family only by (o) the owner as judge of a subjective request (subjective below: the subjective family F1 inside its request scope small_talk_request_v2, first turn only; the prior 'local accepted', admissible while its owner-judged failure rate, owner corrections over its owner-judged runs, stays within tau of the pool references'), (a) a deterministic family verifier (deterministic_verifiers below) or (c) a passed parity paired audit of local@none|family, like any other row. Otherwise it may only START as a REVAS verified start, and only when that start is the argmin at its full price: E[Q] = Q_verify(j) + p_fail(local, family) x Q_repair(j), j the admissible row (a pool reference, or matched-tier or audit evidence) minimizing it. Step 5 runs j's check on every such local answer: a pass adopts the draft; a fail is a repair-mode escalation at j (DESIGN-6 O5: the draft plus the findings, the request and draft prefix reused, fix only what failed). The owner's 447 local-first order is no admission basis (step 2 does not allow it).
local_start.verifier: the cheapest independent check the law can justify for a tool-free answer family: an admissible row's review of the draft against the request (REVAS: PASS, or FAIL with a numbered list of what is wrong or missing). A structural or self-consistency check by the local model itself costs nothing and is NOT independent evidence of the reference's result (the 447 screen passed q2's index error); the review has a measurable quota cost and is priced in E[Q] (the verify and repair cost shapes).
local_start.candidate_floor: capability only, never a family list: a tool-free answer family (tools none, shape answer), a reading with needs_tools none, a read-only node, the request alone (no named file or material), on its FIRST turn only in every family (round 4 of the 448 review, lead decision 1: the reader and the local worker are context-free, so a later short reply is a continuation, approval or refusal; round 3 decision 5 is withdrawn); never for an OS-1 status check-in, status question or assistant-state subject the host did not clear (it needs the host's install-state card), a named file or material, or a floor no local reading lowers (an external action, an approval, a write, shell or hard order, workspace evidence: round 5); for a family whose evidence has a request scope (a deterministic verifier or a checklist parity audit: small talk F1, small_talk_request_v2), ADMISSIBLE only inside that scope, elsewhere at most a REVAS verified start; the host offers the local row for light tool-free readings (Swift lawMayAnswerLocally)
local_start.draft_max_tokens_source: rcc-plugin.mjs LOCAL_WORKER_MAX_TOKENS: the local worker's completion cap, the deterministic upper bound of a draft
local_start.check_pricing: verify(j): j's answer anchor (the shape's measured OS-1 context) plus the draft (uncached) as input, j's answer output as output; repair(j) at the same row inside the provider cache window: the request and draft prefix cached, the findings (bounded by the verify output) uncached, j's answer output as output. Both are upper bounds while no check is measured (O4: the expensive reading when uncertain): a check never outputs more than answering and a repair never more than rewriting. Every check and repair attempt's usage is in the routing ledger for measurement.
local_start.source: lead order for build 448 (2026-10-30): live q2 on 447 ('파이썬 list와 tuple 차이 설명해봐', law F2) bound the local row on basis owner_order and delivered a factual error past the structural screen

deterministic_verifiers_rule: DESIGN-8 step 2 (a) (lead order for build 448, 2026-10-31; reviews of 448): a family whose reference result has no factual content has a quality criterion Core checks with its own code. Small talk (F1), no_claim_reply_v2: a CLOSED grammar (Core lawDeterministicCheck): every clause of the reply is built from closed small-talk lists and the nouns of the owner's own declarative words and ends in a closed courtesy head; empathy and congratulations only for what the request names; a first-person clause only with the reply's own courtesy feeling or its wish for the owner; the owner's language with no letter of another script; within the local worker's completion cap D (the local row only). It admits rows only for the law family it was made for and only after its pre-registered held-out validation passed: zero false passes on every frozen labeled set (the compiler refuses an id without it). It admits every row whose answer it reads (a read-only node's law attempt; round 3, decision 5: small talk's node runs read-only in any lane, the check reading the reply alone; the LOCAL start binds on its first turn only: round 4 of the 448 review, lead decision 1, withdrawing decision 5's later-turn local start; local_start.candidate_floor), each charged its rates ON IT, per class (lawDetClassPFail): every row starts from the same prior, the verifier's measured rejections of reference-quality replies (the references' own verdicts once a snapshot or the ledger has them, else the clean replies of its held-out sets judged as a pool row's), and its own judged verdicts move it at the prior's weight, measured on the SAME requests (round 3, decision 1: the local model's drafts, production small-talk prompt, of the held-out sets' own requests; the corpus drafts that price the realized gate never enter the fit). Round 3 (decision 3): any failure escalates WITHIN the family, once, to the family's reference fixed at bind (the runnable pool reference minimizing the priced step): repair mode (DESIGN-6 O5) with the draft plus the verifier's findings (lawDeterministicFindings), or the full answer when there is no draft; 448's F1 -> F2 re-read is removed. With no runnable reference (every pool exhausted) a pass is evidence by itself and the row stays admissible: a failure holds the request with the draft withheld (round 2, B). A family whose result has factual content (F2 and every other) has none.

F1.name: chat, light, tool-free (small talk inside the subjective scope)

F3x.name: workspace or office document explanation, standard or deep, not code

F10.name: routing self-test without a task (ask back)

families_source: DESIGN-9: a family is the request's structural class (its cost shape, tool need, local candidacy and p_fail key); its benchmark tiers come from the reading's skills and band (skills, skill_rules), never 'always'. Review of 449: F1 is every chat, light, tool-free reading; only a request inside the subjective scope (subjective below) has no tier, any other keeps its skills. U (no reading): the request may need any skill at any band and the constraint holds on each, so every skill's tiers at every band judge it ('every_skill', derived by the compiler from skills; with the pools' current evidence only the references are admissible: Claude publishes no graduate-science tier, Codex no math tier); no hand-picked floor. F10 (the ask-back) has none

ask_back.ko: 뭘 볼까요? ① 라우팅 점검(로컬·Codex·Claude 동시 확인) ② 답변 실력 테스트
ask_back.en: What should I check? (1) routing check (local, Codex and Claude at once) (2) answer-quality test

percentage.basis: the pooled vendor adjacent-effort drop (evidence inversions of unit pct), cross-checked against the replicate run-to-run noise

tolerance.other_units: no tau: a benchmark of any other unit (e.g. other:findings) is no evidence either way and is not counted
tolerance.source: DESIGN-9 section 2 (owner approved 2026-11-02): tau = 1.2 points for every percentage-scale benchmark (n = 29, against 0.89 run-to-run noise), 6 Elo for Elo-scale ones; the 3-sample T1F tau and per-tier taus are retired

light.definition: the answer is directly in textbooks or official docs; easier than the easiest published tier (MMLU-class); the top model is essentially always right

standard.definition: college-exam level, or an ordinary coding task; the top model is right about 90% of the time

deep.definition: graduate or research level, or long engineering work; the top model is often wrong

bands.unread: a request with no reading (family U) is judged on measured deficits
bands.source: DESIGN-9 section 3: difficulty is the probability that the top model gets the request right; light uses the saturation rule (section 4.4) at the anchor p_R(light, skill), learned per (band, skill) from the routing ledger (REVAS failures, escalations, owner corrections) with a Laplace prior at 0.99 (weight: laplace.runs)

skills_source: DESIGN-9 section 4.1: skills map to tiers by skill and band, never 'always': knowledge or fact answers T1 + T1F; writing W1 (documents) or W2 (deliverables); tools U1 (automation), U2 (GUI), U3 (deep web research); coding C1 light, C2 standard, C3 deep or long agentic; math T3M; hard reasoning T3; graduate science T2 (deep only); medicine T2P (medical domain only). A skill's `tiers` are its partition for the inductive fill (section 4.3: never across skills); a tier no skill names (C3S, CSEC, T2V) judges nothing
skill_rules_source: DESIGN-9 section 4.1 (step 1, Read: the local LLM reads the skills, the band and the needs). Review of 449: the reader NAMES the skills (Swift LocalRequestClassifier skills call, its own definitions with examples, gated on labeled development and held-out sets: artifacts OS1_ROUTING_20261027/law449/review1/skills), so a rule maps a named skill to its DESIGN-9 skill and variant one to one, with no reading-to-skill guess: knowledge; science is a knowledge question that at deep is also graduate science (T2 deep only); medicine is a knowledge question in the medical domain (T2P); math T3M; hard reasoning T3; coding C1 light / C2 standard / C3 deep, and long agentic (C3) when a design or write task runs on the agentic cost shape (a new system built in the workspace: the host's shape, not a guess); writing W2 for a new deliverable (named first: a request naming both delivers a new piece) else W1 for work on a supplied text (summarize, edit, proofread, rewrite, translate, analyze); tools U1 automation, U2 GUI, U3 deep web research (U1 at light and standard). The needs the enum call reads are structural: current facts are a fact answer found by web research (DESIGN-9 example L, today's exchange rate: T1F + U1). A reading whose skills were NOT read (a chat, light, tool-free reading the host does not ask about, a failed or timed-out call, a model that reads no skills) names knowledge only for an answer task (chat or explain: the enum call's own definition, 'explain/answer a question'); any other task then has no skill and only the references answer it (unknown skills are never guessed). A subjective request (subjective) has no skill. Within a skill the first matching rule names its variant

anchors.counting: Core lawAnchorOutcome: a judged law outcome (lawJudgedOutcome: a REVAS failure, an escalation, a verifier or check verdict, an owner correction) counted once for each skill of its receipt at its band, keyed by the skill's variant and the row that ran (model@effort)
anchors.estimate: Core lawAnchor (review of 449): an outcome is evidence about p_R only through the failure rate the anchor implies for the row that ran, 1 - sigmoid(logit(p_R) - g), g its capability gap on the skill's tiers at the band (Core lawAnchorGap: the largest logit(s_ref) - logit(s_cell) over the percentage benchmarks; a pool reference 0); a row with no gap (the local model, whose REVAS drafts are judged by its own p_fail) implies no rate and never moves p_R. p_R is the root of the expected failures equalling the observed, the prior counted as laplace.runs reference runs at p0: sum_i n_i (1 - sigmoid(logit p_R - g_i)) + w (1 - p_R) = sum_i f_i + w (1 - p0)

subjective.scope: small_talk_request_v2 (Core lawSubjective: the subjective family and lawSmallTalkScope, a request that asks for nothing but a social reply, never an OS-1 status check-in); review of 449: only a request inside this scope has no skill and is owner-judged (its receipt's owner_judged); any other reading of the family keeps the skills it names. The local row's form o is offered on the first turn only (local_start.candidate_floor)
subjective.rule: DESIGN-9 section 4.8 (owner orders 2026-10-27 and 2026-11-02): for a subjective request (conversation with no facts) the owner is the judge. The local row is admissible there (evidence form o) while its owner-judged failure rate stays within tau of the pool reference's: p_o(c) = f_c / (n_c + laplace.runs), the prior 'local accepted' (no failure), owner corrections the failures; priced like every evidence row on the runtime's escalation event (its structural screen)
